name: GD AI Bridge
description: Lets any AI (via MCP or plain HTTP) read and edit levels in the editor.

port.name: Server port
port.description: Local port of the API server (127.0.0.1 only). Restart the game after changing.

run-minimized.name: Keep running when minimized
run-minimized.description: While you are in the editor, the game keeps running when minimized, so the AI can keep working in the background.
